messages.author: 0bfeefd4d077b98c
messages.subject: Identifying and filtering Z-linked loci
parts:
Hi there, 

Is there an easy way in the newest version of dartR to filter Z-linked loci? We have a work around of doing it previously under the guise of a XY system, but I was hoping/wondering if there  had been a recent update that allowed us to filter Z-linked loci out directly. 

Cheers,
Lana

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Identifying and filtering Z-linked loci
parts:
Hi Lana,

You can try the functions gl.report.sexlinked and gl.filter.sexlinked where both systems (XX/XY and ZZ/ZW) are supported.  I recommend you to read carefully the function documentation and the last discussions about these functions:

https://groups.google.com/g/dartr/c/geiTqyqSYmI/m/NrHE2H1xBgAJ 

To install the developing version of dartR:

> library(dartR)
> gl.install.vanilla.dartR(flavour = "dev")
# Restart your R session: Menu > Session > Restart R
> library(dartR)

Cheers,
Luis
